versions.changelog:
Agent Browser 1.0.0

- Initial release of Agent Browser, a fast Rust-based headless browser automation CLI with Node.js fallback.
- Enables web navigation, interaction (clicking, typing, filling forms), and structured page snapshots using simple commands.
- Supports screenshots, PDF export, video recording, and accessible semantic element selection.
- Includes advanced features: network interception, session state saving/loading, JavaScript evaluation, tabs, frames, dialogs, cookies, and storage management.
- Suitable for automated web testing, data extraction, UI testing, and AI web agent integration.
